ops.text: SendMessage to a workflow subagent's raw agent id (a7e6a10ac1f61999f in wf_f79d45a5-908) "resumed" it as a second live instance while the workflow's own instance was still running. Both instances appended to the same agent-<id>.jsonl as separate parentUuid chains (95 leaves) and both received later messages. Each saw the other's edits in the shared worktree as an unknown "second writer": one instance kept editing while the other returned early asking for an ownership ruling. Workaround: never SendMessage a workflow-internal agent id. Queue the amendment for a follow-up stage, or resume the run once it has ended.
